items.title: Strategic Priority - Resilient and Future Ready Organization
COR-TRY-24-033, Moody’s Credit Rating Update
notes:
In response to questions from the Committee, Lory McDonald, Manager of Treasury Services & Corporate Accounting, stated that staff will investigate the municipality's debt levels in comparison to other municipalities and provide a report back to the Committee. Connie MacDonald, Chief Communications and Strategy Officer, added that a report on long-term fiscal sustainability will be presented next month, offering a more detailed analysis of debt levels.

Responding to questions from the Committee, Tricia Alpaugh, Director of Treasury Services/Acting Treasurer, clarified that Moody’s evaluation aligns with the fiscal year-end after the audit opinion has been issued. The evaluation for the 2023 fiscal year was completed last spring, and their report was delivered in the summer. Following the next audit, Moody’s will issue their opinion on the 2024 fiscal year next spring.

Received for information.

items.title: PDL-CUL-24-016, Public Art for Langs Drive Redevelopment
notes:
Rod Regier, Commissioner of Planning, Development & Legislative Services, introduced the report, emphasizing the significance of a new development involving a seven-story residential building. He noted that public art is a key component of the project, as the location sees high traffic and offers opportunities for resident engagement. He clarified that this funding has no impact on the tax levy.

Committee members requested clarification on the location of the public artwork and acknowledged the efforts of the Public Art Advisory Committee in supporting the project.

K. Williams joined the meeting at 9:20 am.

N. Salonen left the meeting at 9:25 am.
